messages.subject: ggplot2 speed
parts:
I do some computations, create a list of 4 plots using ggplot2, and render them to a single plotOutput using grid.arrange().

The computation takes about 0.03 seconds, creating the 4 plots takes 0.14 seconds all together, and rendering using grid.arrange() takes about 0.7 seconds.

As a user moves a slider, a response time of nearly 1 second is not very interactive compared with user expectations. Especially given the computation time is so quick.

Can anyone recommend a faster approach? If so, roughly how much faster? I'd like an idea of how much improvement I can expect before I take the time to learn another approach.

Jonathan
